Hyderabad Startup Leanwatts Secures $2 Million Seed Funding

Hyderabad-based power electronics startup Leanwatts has successfully raised $2 million in seed funding. The company plans to use this investment to scale its operations and achieve annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth. Leanwatts focuses on power electronics solutions.
